summary: Canton Strategic Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a share repurchase program approved by its board on June 11, 2026, authorizing up to $50 million of common stock repurchases. Repurchases may occur via open market or privately-negotiated transactions under Rule 10b-18. The company entered into a non-exclusive repurchase agreement with Virtu Americas LLC on June 12, 2026, paying $0.02/share commission. The program’s timing and amount depend on capital resources, market conditions, and securities law limits. Watch for execution pace and impact on share price.
